categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches P2P label and modifies net_processing.cpp to change peer ping timeout logic during block download.
categories.rationale: Fixes an issue where slow connections prioritize block downloads over pings and cause valid peers to be dropped after 20 minutes. As the description notes, peers can prioritize block responses over pings, triggering the timeout and dropping peers that are behaving correctly. While this improves liveness and prevents spurious disconnects during block download, the 20-minute timeout is a relatively narrow edge case, making it worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The test changes add a P2P functional test and register it in test_runner.py, which the category explicitly excludes as area-specific test coverage.
categories.rationale: Non-member; category definition specifies that a test pinning the behavior of a particular area belongs to that area rather than test infrastructure.
